inputInstructions: Run on a whole asset or a folder after the SYSTEM GenAI metadata pipeline has described its files. seedWithExistingMetadata feeds the asset's existing metadata into the prompt. reuseExistingKeys fills a key the asset already carries when fieldMapping names it (Material, Colour, Tags), never overwrites a value a person edited, and clears a genai_asset_* field a re-run no longer produces; off, every run writes the plain genai_asset_* layer. fieldMapping lists, per summarised field (title, description, keywords, category, subcategory, style, materials, colors), the existing key names that field may fill; names match ignoring case, spacing and a plural. classificationVocabulary is the category, subcategory, style, material and color vocabulary the model chooses from; edit it and fieldMapping with 'vamscli pipeline template update --config-body-file' (allowUnlisted false restricts the model to the listed values). A deploy restores the shipped default.

tagSchema.label: Seed the prompt with the asset's existing metadata
tagSchema.description: Feed the asset's existing metadata into the summary prompt.

tagSchema.label: Reuse existing metadata keys
tagSchema.description: On a re-run, fill a key the asset already carries when fieldMapping names it, never overwrite a value a person edited, show the model its earlier summary so the wording stays stable, and clear a genai_asset_* field the run no longer produces. Off writes the plain genai_asset_* layer every run.
